### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

Read more

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

### AI-ready data centers

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,
scale, and flexibility.

[Glowing translucent cubes with internal circuitry connected by blue light beams.]

### Future-proofed workplaces

Create agile, resilient workplaces that evolve with employee needs and deliver incredible customer
experiences everywhere.

[Transparent cube containing a miniature night city with glowing skyscrapers and highways.]

### Digital resilience

Keep your organization securely up and running in the face of any disruption—from cyberattacks to
third-party outages and other technical failures.

[Grid of glowing digital cubes containing miniature scenes of wind turbines, cities, and nature.]

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Salesforce CRM FAQs

### What is Salesforce?

Salesforce is the [**#1 AI CRM**][86] (customer relationship management) platform. We bring
companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications — powered by [agentic
AI][87] and data — that help every department, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and
IT, work as one. You can learn more about [what Salesforce is][88] and [what Salesforce does][89] by
visiting [our official resources][90]. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads,
close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic
platform.

### What is CRM software and why do businesses in India need it?

[**CRM**][91] stands for **customer relationship management. **It’s a technology for managing all
your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system
helps you:

**• Organise **contact information, leads, and customer service data
**• Automate** tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails**
• Analyse** data to understand customer behaviour and business performance

A CRM, especially one powered by AI like Salesforce, is essential for growth because it gives you
a** single**, [**360-degree view** of every customer][92], allowing you to build stronger, more
profitable relationships at scale.

### What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce?

[**Agentic AI**][93] refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act
[**autonomously**][94] to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike
traditional [AI][95] that only generates content or analyses data, agentic AI can reason, plan
multistep actions, and execute tasks.

In Salesforce, agentic AI — part of our [**Agentforce**][96] technology — is used to:

**• Automate **complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution
**• Predict** business outcomes, such as which deals are likely to close
**• Personalise** every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels

### How does Salesforce CRM help businesses grow in India?

Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from[ startups and
small businesses][97] to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and
scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or
marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for
what you use and have an[ AI and CRM][98] platform that can grow with your business.

[Salesforce Starter][99] helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of
sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup
process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of
mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does Ailoitte mean by AI-native engineering?

AI-native engineering means we do not use AI as a side tool after planning is complete. We design
delivery around AI from the start, combining senior architects, governed AI workflows, automated QA,
and strong human checkpoints to ship software faster without losing control.

### What kinds of products does Ailoitte build?

Ailoitte builds mobile apps, web platforms, AI-powered workflows, internal business systems,
healthcare software, hiring automation tools, and modernization solutions for legacy systems. Our
focus is on production-ready software that drives measurable business outcomes.

### How is Ailoitte different from traditional development agencies?

Traditional agencies often bill by hours and team size. Ailoitte focuses on fixed outcomes, governed
delivery, faster execution, and predictable quality. Instead of selling effort, we structure
delivery around milestones, speed, compliance, and business impact.

### Is Ailoitte a fit for startups or enterprises?

Both. Startups usually work with us for MVPs, faster validation, and lean delivery. Enterprises work
with us for secure engineering, modernization, AI adoption, and compliance-focused implementation.
The delivery model is adapted to the stage and complexity of the business.

### How quickly can you start?

Project timelines depend on scope, but many engagements start with a short assessment, roadmap, or
audit. From there, we define a fixed outcome and delivery path so teams can move quickly without
spending months in pre-project planning.

per quarter to maintain velocity.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does Ailoitte mean by AI-native engineering?

AI-native engineering means we do not use AI as a side tool after planning is complete. We design
delivery around AI from the start, combining senior architects, governed AI workflows, automated QA,
and strong human checkpoints to ship software faster without losing control.

### What kinds of products does Ailoitte build?

Ailoitte builds mobile apps, web platforms, AI-powered workflows, internal business systems,
healthcare software, hiring automation tools, and modernization solutions for legacy systems. Our
focus is on production-ready software that drives measurable business outcomes.

### How is Ailoitte different from traditional development agencies?

Traditional agencies often bill by hours and team size. Ailoitte focuses on fixed outcomes, governed
delivery, faster execution, and predictable quality. Instead of selling effort, we structure
delivery around milestones, speed, compliance, and business impact.

### Is Ailoitte a fit for startups or enterprises?

Both. Startups usually work with us for MVPs, faster validation, and lean delivery. Enterprises work
with us for secure engineering, modernization, AI adoption, and compliance-focused implementation.
The delivery model is adapted to the stage and complexity of the business.

### How quickly can you start?

Project timelines depend on scope, but many engagements start with a short assessment, roadmap, or
audit. From there, we define a fixed outcome and delivery path so teams can move quickly without
spending months in pre-project planning.

### AI in pharmaceuticals

The pharmaceutical industry is rapidly adopting AI technologies. We have worked on projects
utilizing AI models to extract valuable data from clinical trials, drug interactions, and molecular
structures to accelerate drug discovery through AI-powered solutions.

### AI in Retail

Our solutions empower retailers to create personalized shopping experiences with AI-driven insights,
helping deliver more effective customer experiences while optimizing inventory and operations.
Businesses optimize inventory and boost sales. Cognitive AI, NLP, and computer vision technologies
enable advanced retail analytics experiences, enhancing customer satisfaction and loyalty.

### AI for Manufacturing

Transforming the manufacturing landscape with innovative predictive maintenance, quality control,
and supply chain optimization. By leveraging advanced machine learning models and data analytics,
equipment AI helps manufacturers reduce downtime, enhance product quality, and streamline
operations. Our expertise empowers manufacturers to stay competitive in an industry driven by
innovation and efficiency.

### AI for Energy

We are at the forefront of revolutionizing the energy sector with AI-driven solutions. Developing
sophisticated predictive models for energy consumption forecasting, anomaly detection in grid
operations, and optimization of renewable energy resources. Our AI solutions support energy
companies in reducing operational costs, improving grid reliability, forecasting demand and supply,
managing smart grids, and contributing to a sustainable future through efficient energy management.

### AI in Media and Entertainment

Pioneering media and entertainment solutions with cutting-edge AI technologies that enhance content
creation, distribution, and audience engagement. From advanced recommendation systems, content
analysis, automated content generation, and personalized recommendations to immersive AR/VR
experiences and captivating storytelling. We help media companies thrive in an increasingly
competitive and rapidly evolving digital landscape.

## What Will You Learn on Deep-ML?
* **Machine Learning Fundamentals** — Master core ML concepts and algorithms including regression,
  classification, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.
* **Deep Neural Networks** — Explore advanced neural network architectures including CNNs, RNNs,
  transformers, and attention mechanisms.
* **Computer Vision** — Unlock the power of visual data analysis with image classification, object
  detection, and segmentation problems.
* **Natural Language Processing** — Harness the potential of language in AI with tokenization,
  embeddings, and sequence model challenges.

## Why Deep-ML?
* **Constantly updating problems** — Our open source community is always adding new ML challenges.
* **Problems made by professionals** — Machine learning scientists and engineers create all
  problems.
* **Choice of learning** — Learn Linear Algebra, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Computer
  Vision.
* **Free to use** — Practice as much as you want, all problems are free.
* **Community Support** — Connect with peers and mentors for guidance and collaboration.
* **Designed for career growth** — Problems designed to help you prepare for ML interviews and grow
  in your career.

## How Deep-ML Works

Deep-ML is a free, open-source machine learning practice platform. Browse ML coding challenges by
difficulty and category. Write Python solutions in the browser-based code editor. Get instant
feedback against test cases. Track your progress across collections and earn badges. Work with real
datasets in labs. Learn through interactive articles with math visualizations.

About

## What is DeepSeek?

DeepSeek is an AI research lab from China building some of the world's most capable open-weight
language models. Their flagship models — including DeepSeek-V3, R1, and the specialized Coder series
— have demonstrated performance rivaling top proprietary systems, while remaining freely accessible
to developers worldwide.

Built on efficient Mixture-of-Experts architecture, DeepSeek models excel at reasoning, coding,
mathematics, and multilingual conversations. The company gained global attention in early 2025 when
their R1 model matched OpenAI's o1 on key benchmarks — trained at a fraction of the cost.

### Why developers choose DeepSeek

**Open weights** Models on Hugging Face under permissive licenses
**50+ languages** Strong multilingual performance
**Code intelligence** Generation, debugging, documentation
**Flexible sizing** From 1.5B to 685B parameters

### Model lineup

DeepSeek-V3.2 General-purpose with hybrid thinking
DeepSeek-R1 Reasoning specialist for math and logic
DeepSeek-Coder Code completion and review
DeepSeek-VL Vision-language multimodal
Experience

## What to expect

A clean, focused interface designed for getting things done.

### Clean interface
* No clutter, no distractions
* Works on desktop, tablet, mobile
* Dark mode available
* Conversation history saved locally

### Quality answers
* Detailed explanations when needed
* Code with syntax highlighting
* Step-by-step reasoning
* Citations where possible

No interruptions. No upsells. Just a helpful AI.

real-world problems and support communities in need. Our "AI for Good" initiative reflects our
commitment to environmental stewardship, conservation, and social impact.

the globe. Our technology analyzes satellite imagery, drone footage, aerial photography, and camera
trap data to protect biodiversity and monitor environmental change. These systems use modern
transformer-based detectors and lightweight CNNs optimized for different sensors and compute
environments—from edge devices in remote locations to country-scale processing pipelines. All
projects were delivered on time with measurable real-world impact.

endangered species across African reserves using camera trap networks and aerial imagery. The system
generates real-time population estimates, movement patterns, and hotspot maps that cut field-team
response time by 40%. This allows conservation teams to deploy resources more effectively and
respond faster to threats like poaching.

systems using drone and camera-trap data across different habitat types. The resulting

## 为什么越来越多人使用 DeepL

从日常交流到专业文档，DeepL 正成为全球用户首选的AI翻译工具

### 一、相比传统机器翻译更加自然

传统机器翻译工具往往采用逐词替换或简单的统计匹配方式，导致译文生硬、语序混乱，尤其在处理中英文互译时
，常常出现"翻译腔"严重的问题。而DeepL基于自研的**卷积神经网络（CNN）与Transformer混合架构**，能够从
整体上理解句子结构，输出的译文更接近人类自然表达。无论是日常口语对话还是正式书面文体，DeepL都能给出
流畅自然的翻译结果，这让它在**AI翻译**领域迅速积累了口碑。

📌
关键优势：DeepL的神经网络在数百万高质量平行语料上训练而成，涵盖文学、新闻、法律、科技等多元领域，确
保译文不仅准确，更具备"语感"。

### 二、语义理解能力更强

一词多义是翻译中的常见难点。以英文单词"bank"为例，它可能指"银行"也可能指"河岸"。传统翻译工具往往只能
根据统计概率选择最常见的释义，而**DeepL的AI模型能够结合上下文语境进行判断**，大幅降低了误译率。在**
智能翻译**场景中，DeepL对代词指代、隐喻表达、文化特定用语的理解尤为出色，这使得它在商务沟通和学术写
作中表现出众。

### 三、长句翻译更流畅

许多在线翻译工具在面对长难句时容易"崩溃"——译文支离破碎、逻辑混乱。DeepL针对长文本做了专门的模型优化
，能够妥善处理嵌套从句、并列结构和复杂修饰关系。对于超过200词的长段落，DeepL依然能保持译文的结构完整
性和逻辑连贯性，这是它在**在线语言转换**领域脱颖而出的关键能力之一。用户在处理合同条款、学术论文或技
术文档时，不必再逐句拆分，可以整段粘贴获得高质量译文。

### 四、更适合商务与专业场景

在**文档翻译**和商务邮件翻译场景中，用词准确性和语气得体性至关重要。DeepL支持正式/非正式语气调节功能
，用户可以根据收件对象选择合适的话风。例如，给海外客户发送邮件时选择"正式"语气，DeepL会自动使用更礼
貌、更专业的措辞；而在团队内部沟通时，则可选择"非正式"模式，让译文更加亲切自然。这一功能深受跨国企业
和外贸从业者的青睐。

💡
实际应用：某跨境电商团队使用DeepL进行**多语言互译**后，客户邮件回复效率提升了60%，翻译准确率比之前使
用的工具高出近30个百分点。

### 五、学术论文翻译体验优秀

对于科研人员和高校师生而言，**英文翻译中文**以及**中文翻译英文**的质量直接影响论文发表和学术交流的效
率。DeepL在处理学术文本时，能够较好地保留专业术语的准确性，同时让译文的行文风格符合学术规范。许多用
户反馈，使用DeepL翻译的论文初稿，只需要少量人工润色即可达到投稿标准，大幅节省了时间成本。尤其在医学
、工程、计算机科学等领域，DeepL对专业词汇的识别率显著高于同类工具。

### 六、支持正式语气优化

DeepL独有的语气调节功能不仅限于"正式/非正式"二选一，其底层AI模型能够根据上下文自动判断最合适的表达方
式。在翻译法律文件、政府公文、商业合同等高度正式的文本时，DeepL会自动选用庄重得体的措辞；而在翻译社
交媒体内容、博客文章等轻松文体时，则会采用更活泼自然的表达。这种智能化的语气适配能力，让DeepL成为真

## AI翻译能力深度解析

了解DeepL背后的技术原理，理解为什么它的翻译更自然

### 什么是神经网络翻译（NMT）

神经网络翻译（Neural Machine
Translation）是近年来AI翻译领域的革命性技术。与传统的统计机器翻译（SMT）不同，NMT使用深度神经网络对
整个输入句子进行编码，生成一个包含完整语义信息的向量表示，再由解码器逐词生成目标语言译文。这种方法能
够捕捉到词语之间的长距离依赖关系，使得译文更加连贯自然。DeepL是最早将卷积神经网络应用于翻译任务的团
队之一，其独特的**编码器-解码器架构**在翻译质量上实现了质的飞跃。

🔬
**技术要点：**DeepL的神经网络包含数十亿个参数，训练数据来自海量高质量平行语料库。与基于循环神经网络
（RNN）的传统NMT系统不同，DeepL采用的CNN架构可以并行处理整个句子，训练速度更快，且能更好地捕捉长距离
语义依赖。

### DeepL为什么翻译更自然

DeepL翻译自然的秘密在于**多层注意力机制**和精细化的数据训练。在训练过程中，DeepL的模型不仅学习词语之
间的对应关系，还会学习句式结构、修辞手法、甚至文体风格。例如，当翻译一句带有比喻色彩的英文时，DeepL
能够识别出其中的修辞意图，并在中文译文中找到最贴切的对应表达，而不是生硬地直译。这种"理解后再表达"的
能力，是DeepL与普通翻译工具最本质的区别。

此外，DeepL持续从用户反馈中优化模型。每次用户对译文进行修改或评分，这些数据都会被用于后续的模型迭代
，形成一个不断进化的翻译生态系统。这也是为什么随着使用时间的增长，越来越多用户感受到DeepL的翻译质量
在稳步提升。

### AI如何理解上下文

上下文理解是翻译中最具挑战性的环节。一个词的含义往往取决于它所在的句子、段落乃至整篇文章的语境。Deep
L通过**自注意力机制（Self-Attention）**让模型在处理每个词时都能"看到"句子中的所有其他词，从而准确判
断每个词的语义角色。例如，在翻译"苹果很好吃"和"苹果发布了新手机"这两句话时，DeepL能根据上下文准确区
分"苹果"是指水果还是公司品牌，并给出正确的英文翻译。

对于更复杂的篇章级上下文，DeepL的模型在训练时被喂入了大量连续段落数据，使其学会了跨句子的指代消解和
话题跟踪能力。这意味着在翻译长篇文章时，DeepL能够保持术语一致性，避免出现前后译文矛盾的情况。

### 为什么长文本翻译更难

长文本翻译的难度呈指数级增长。随着文本长度增加，需要处理的信息量急剧膨胀，模型必须同时关注语法正确性
、术语一致性、逻辑连贯性和风格统一性。普通的NMT系统在面对超过500词的长文本时，往往会出现"注意力稀释"
现象——模型无法有效分配注意力权重，导致后半部分的翻译质量明显下降。DeepL通过**分段优化算法**和**全局
一致性校验**解决了这一问题，即使是数千词的文档，也能保持从头到尾的翻译质量稳定。

📊
**实测数据：**在第三方评测中，DeepL在处理1000词以上的长文本时，术语一致性得分比同类工具高出约22%，逻
辑连贯性评分领先约18%。

### 多语言模型如何优化语义

DeepL目前支持超过30种语言，覆盖上百种语言对组合。不同于为每个语言对训练独立模型的做法，DeepL采用了**
多语言共享编码器**的设计。这意味着所有语言共享同一个语义理解层，模型在学习英文到中文的翻译时，也能同
时提升法文到德文的翻译能力。这种"迁移学习"效应使得DeepL在处理小语种翻译时依然能保持较高水准，不会因
为训练数据不足而出现质量断崖。

更值得一提的是，DeepL的模型在训练时特别注重**语义保真度**——即确保译文的含义与原文完全一致，不增不减
。这在法律、医学、金融等对翻译准确性要求极高的领域尤为关键。DeepL通过引入对抗训练和语义相似度约束，
有效减少了AI翻译中常见的"幻觉"现象（即模型自行添加原文中不存在的信息）。

## AI翻译能力深度解析

了解DeepL背后的技术原理，理解为什么它的翻译更自然

### 什么是神经网络翻译（NMT）

神经网络翻译（Neural Machine
Translation）是近年来AI翻译领域的革命性技术。与传统的统计机器翻译（SMT）不同，NMT使用深度神经网络对
整个输入句子进行编码，生成一个包含完整语义信息的向量表示，再由解码器逐词生成目标语言译文。这种方法能
够捕捉到词语之间的长距离依赖关系，使得译文更加连贯自然。DeepL是最早将卷积神经网络应用于翻译任务的团
队之一，其独特的**编码器-解码器架构**在翻译质量上实现了质的飞跃。

🔬
**技术要点：**DeepL的神经网络包含数十亿个参数，训练数据来自海量高质量平行语料库。与基于循环神经网络
（RNN）的传统NMT系统不同，DeepL采用的CNN架构可以并行处理整个句子，训练速度更快，且能更好地捕捉长距离
语义依赖。

### DeepL为什么翻译更自然

DeepL翻译自然的秘密在于**多层注意力机制**和精细化的数据训练。在训练过程中，DeepL的模型不仅学习词语之
间的对应关系，还会学习句式结构、修辞手法、甚至文体风格。例如，当翻译一句带有比喻色彩的英文时，DeepL
能够识别出其中的修辞意图，并在中文译文中找到最贴切的对应表达，而不是生硬地直译。这种"理解后再表达"的
能力，是DeepL与普通翻译工具最本质的区别。

此外，DeepL持续从用户反馈中优化模型。每次用户对译文进行修改或评分，这些数据都会被用于后续的模型迭代
，形成一个不断进化的翻译生态系统。这也是为什么随着使用时间的增长，越来越多用户感受到DeepL的翻译质量
在稳步提升。

### AI如何理解上下文

上下文理解是翻译中最具挑战性的环节。一个词的含义往往取决于它所在的句子、段落乃至整篇文章的语境。Deep
L通过**自注意力机制（Self-Attention）**让模型在处理每个词时都能"看到"句子中的所有其他词，从而准确判
断每个词的语义角色。例如，在翻译"苹果很好吃"和"苹果发布了新手机"这两句话时，DeepL能根据上下文准确区
分"苹果"是指水果还是公司品牌，并给出正确的英文翻译。

对于更复杂的篇章级上下文，DeepL的模型在训练时被喂入了大量连续段落数据，使其学会了跨句子的指代消解和
话题跟踪能力。这意味着在翻译长篇文章时，DeepL能够保持术语一致性，避免出现前后译文矛盾的情况。

### 为什么长文本翻译更难

长文本翻译的难度呈指数级增长。随着文本长度增加，需要处理的信息量急剧膨胀，模型必须同时关注语法正确性
、术语一致性、逻辑连贯性和风格统一性。普通的NMT系统在面对超过500词的长文本时，往往会出现"注意力稀释"
现象——模型无法有效分配注意力权重，导致后半部分的翻译质量明显下降。DeepL通过**分段优化算法**和**全局
一致性校验**解决了这一问题，即使是数千词的文档，也能保持从头到尾的翻译质量稳定。

📊
**实测数据：**在第三方评测中，DeepL在处理1000词以上的长文本时，术语一致性得分比同类工具高出约22%，逻
辑连贯性评分领先约18%。

### 多语言模型如何优化语义

DeepL目前支持超过30种语言，覆盖上百种语言对组合。不同于为每个语言对训练独立模型的做法，DeepL采用了**
多语言共享编码器**的设计。这意味着所有语言共享同一个语义理解层，模型在学习英文到中文的翻译时，也能同
时提升法文到德文的翻译能力。这种"迁移学习"效应使得DeepL在处理小语种翻译时依然能保持较高水准，不会因
为训练数据不足而出现质量断崖。

更值得一提的是，DeepL的模型在训练时特别注重**语义保真度**——即确保译文的含义与原文完全一致，不增不减
。这在法律、医学、金融等对翻译准确性要求极高的领域尤为关键。DeepL通过引入对抗训练和语义相似度约束，
有效减少了AI翻译中常见的"幻觉"现象（即模型自行添加原文中不存在的信息）。

## AI翻译能力深度解析

了解DeepL背后的技术原理，理解为什么它的翻译更自然

### 什么是神经网络翻译（NMT）

神经网络翻译（Neural Machine
Translation）是近年来AI翻译领域的革命性技术。与传统的统计机器翻译（SMT）不同，NMT使用深度神经网络对
整个输入句子进行编码，生成一个包含完整语义信息的向量表示，再由解码器逐词生成目标语言译文。这种方法能
够捕捉到词语之间的长距离依赖关系，使得译文更加连贯自然。DeepL是最早将卷积神经网络应用于翻译任务的团
队之一，其独特的**编码器-解码器架构**在翻译质量上实现了质的飞跃。

🔬
**技术要点：**DeepL的神经网络包含数十亿个参数，训练数据来自海量高质量平行语料库。与基于循环神经网络
（RNN）的传统NMT系统不同，DeepL采用的CNN架构可以并行处理整个句子，训练速度更快，且能更好地捕捉长距离
语义依赖。

### DeepL为什么翻译更自然

DeepL翻译自然的秘密在于**多层注意力机制**和精细化的数据训练。在训练过程中，DeepL的模型不仅学习词语之
间的对应关系，还会学习句式结构、修辞手法、甚至文体风格。例如，当翻译一句带有比喻色彩的英文时，DeepL
能够识别出其中的修辞意图，并在中文译文中找到最贴切的对应表达，而不是生硬地直译。这种"理解后再表达"的
能力，是DeepL与普通翻译工具最本质的区别。

此外，DeepL持续从用户反馈中优化模型。每次用户对译文进行修改或评分，这些数据都会被用于后续的模型迭代
，形成一个不断进化的翻译生态系统。这也是为什么随着使用时间的增长，越来越多用户感受到DeepL的翻译质量
在稳步提升。

### AI如何理解上下文

上下文理解是翻译中最具挑战性的环节。一个词的含义往往取决于它所在的句子、段落乃至整篇文章的语境。Deep
L通过**自注意力机制（Self-Attention）**让模型在处理每个词时都能"看到"句子中的所有其他词，从而准确判
断每个词的语义角色。例如，在翻译"苹果很好吃"和"苹果发布了新手机"这两句话时，DeepL能根据上下文准确区
分"苹果"是指水果还是公司品牌，并给出正确的英文翻译。

对于更复杂的篇章级上下文，DeepL的模型在训练时被喂入了大量连续段落数据，使其学会了跨句子的指代消解和
话题跟踪能力。这意味着在翻译长篇文章时，DeepL能够保持术语一致性，避免出现前后译文矛盾的情况。

### 为什么长文本翻译更难

长文本翻译的难度呈指数级增长。随着文本长度增加，需要处理的信息量急剧膨胀，模型必须同时关注语法正确性
、术语一致性、逻辑连贯性和风格统一性。普通的NMT系统在面对超过500词的长文本时，往往会出现"注意力稀释"
现象——模型无法有效分配注意力权重，导致后半部分的翻译质量明显下降。DeepL通过**分段优化算法**和**全局
一致性校验**解决了这一问题，即使是数千词的文档，也能保持从头到尾的翻译质量稳定。

📊
**实测数据：**在第三方评测中，DeepL在处理1000词以上的长文本时，术语一致性得分比同类工具高出约22%，逻
辑连贯性评分领先约18%。

### 多语言模型如何优化语义

DeepL目前支持超过30种语言，覆盖上百种语言对组合。不同于为每个语言对训练独立模型的做法，DeepL采用了**
多语言共享编码器**的设计。这意味着所有语言共享同一个语义理解层，模型在学习英文到中文的翻译时，也能同
时提升法文到德文的翻译能力。这种"迁移学习"效应使得DeepL在处理小语种翻译时依然能保持较高水准，不会因
为训练数据不足而出现质量断崖。

更值得一提的是，DeepL的模型在训练时特别注重**语义保真度**——即确保译文的含义与原文完全一致，不增不减
。这在法律、医学、金融等对翻译准确性要求极高的领域尤为关键。DeepL通过引入对抗训练和语义相似度约束，
有效减少了AI翻译中常见的"幻觉"现象（即模型自行添加原文中不存在的信息）。

## AI翻译能力深度解析

了解DeepL背后的技术原理，理解为什么它的翻译更自然

### 什么是神经网络翻译（NMT）

神经网络翻译（Neural Machine
Translation）是近年来AI翻译领域的革命性技术。与传统的统计机器翻译（SMT）不同，NMT使用深度神经网络对
整个输入句子进行编码，生成一个包含完整语义信息的向量表示，再由解码器逐词生成目标语言译文。这种方法能
够捕捉到词语之间的长距离依赖关系，使得译文更加连贯自然。DeepL是最早将卷积神经网络应用于翻译任务的团
队之一，其独特的**编码器-解码器架构**在翻译质量上实现了质的飞跃。

🔬
**技术要点：**DeepL的神经网络包含数十亿个参数，训练数据来自海量高质量平行语料库。与基于循环神经网络
（RNN）的传统NMT系统不同，DeepL采用的CNN架构可以并行处理整个句子，训练速度更快，且能更好地捕捉长距离
语义依赖。

### DeepL为什么翻译更自然

DeepL翻译自然的秘密在于**多层注意力机制**和精细化的数据训练。在训练过程中，DeepL的模型不仅学习词语之
间的对应关系，还会学习句式结构、修辞手法、甚至文体风格。例如，当翻译一句带有比喻色彩的英文时，DeepL
能够识别出其中的修辞意图，并在中文译文中找到最贴切的对应表达，而不是生硬地直译。这种"理解后再表达"的
能力，是DeepL与普通翻译工具最本质的区别。

此外，DeepL持续从用户反馈中优化模型。每次用户对译文进行修改或评分，这些数据都会被用于后续的模型迭代
，形成一个不断进化的翻译生态系统。这也是为什么随着使用时间的增长，越来越多用户感受到DeepL的翻译质量
在稳步提升。

### AI如何理解上下文

上下文理解是翻译中最具挑战性的环节。一个词的含义往往取决于它所在的句子、段落乃至整篇文章的语境。Deep
L通过**自注意力机制（Self-Attention）**让模型在处理每个词时都能"看到"句子中的所有其他词，从而准确判
断每个词的语义角色。例如，在翻译"苹果很好吃"和"苹果发布了新手机"这两句话时，DeepL能根据上下文准确区
分"苹果"是指水果还是公司品牌，并给出正确的英文翻译。

对于更复杂的篇章级上下文，DeepL的模型在训练时被喂入了大量连续段落数据，使其学会了跨句子的指代消解和
话题跟踪能力。这意味着在翻译长篇文章时，DeepL能够保持术语一致性，避免出现前后译文矛盾的情况。

### 为什么长文本翻译更难

长文本翻译的难度呈指数级增长。随着文本长度增加，需要处理的信息量急剧膨胀，模型必须同时关注语法正确性
、术语一致性、逻辑连贯性和风格统一性。普通的NMT系统在面对超过500词的长文本时，往往会出现"注意力稀释"
现象——模型无法有效分配注意力权重，导致后半部分的翻译质量明显下降。DeepL通过**分段优化算法**和**全局
一致性校验**解决了这一问题，即使是数千词的文档，也能保持从头到尾的翻译质量稳定。

📊
**实测数据：**在第三方评测中，DeepL在处理1000词以上的长文本时，术语一致性得分比同类工具高出约22%，逻
辑连贯性评分领先约18%。

### 多语言模型如何优化语义

DeepL目前支持超过30种语言，覆盖上百种语言对组合。不同于为每个语言对训练独立模型的做法，DeepL采用了**
多语言共享编码器**的设计。这意味着所有语言共享同一个语义理解层，模型在学习英文到中文的翻译时，也能同
时提升法文到德文的翻译能力。这种"迁移学习"效应使得DeepL在处理小语种翻译时依然能保持较高水准，不会因
为训练数据不足而出现质量断崖。

更值得一提的是，DeepL的模型在训练时特别注重**语义保真度**——即确保译文的含义与原文完全一致，不增不减
。这在法律、医学、金融等对翻译准确性要求极高的领域尤为关键。DeepL通过引入对抗训练和语义相似度约束，
有效减少了AI翻译中常见的"幻觉"现象（即模型自行添加原文中不存在的信息）。

Pro）则提供无限量翻译、更大文件上传、术语库管理、翻译历史同步、API接口等高级功能，适合高频用户和企业
团队。用户可根据自身需求先体验免费版再决定是否升级。

DeepL翻译的内容安全吗？

DeepL高度重视用户数据安全。所有传输均采用TLS加密，翻译完成后服务器不会存储用户的文本内容。对于DeepL
Pro付费用户，翻译数据在处理后立即删除，不会用于模型训练。企业用户还可选择签订数据处理协议，确保符合G
DPR等国际隐私法规要求。因此，使用DeepL进行**文档翻译**和商务翻译是安全可靠的。

DeepL支持浏览器划词翻译吗？

支持。DeepL提供Chrome、Edge和Firefox浏览器扩展，安装后可在任意网页上选中文本直接翻译，无需离开当前页
面。划词翻译支持多种语言组合，用户可在扩展设置中自定义源语言和目标语言。这一功能让阅读外文网站、查阅
海外资料的体验变得极为流畅，是**在线语言转换**场景中非常受欢迎的功能。

DeepL的术语库功能怎么用？

DeepL
Pro用户可以使用术语库功能自定义特定词汇的翻译。例如，你可以规定"API"始终翻译为"应用程序接口"而非"接
口"，或将公司产品名称固定为特定译法。术语库设置后会自动应用到所有翻译中，确保**多语言互译**时品牌术
语和行业专有名词的一致性。这在企业多语言协作和品牌本地化中非常实用。

DeepL支持哪些文件格式的翻译？

DeepL目前支持上传并翻译以下文件格式：PDF、Word（.docx/.doc）、PowerPoint（.pptx/.ppt）、Excel（.xlsx
/.xls）、TXT纯文本文件以及HTML文件。上传后译文将保留原始文档的排版、图片和表格结构，用户可直接下载使
用。这项**文档翻译**功能极大地简化了多语言文档的处理流程。

DeepL翻译的准确率有多高？

在多项独立评测中，DeepL的翻译质量持续领先于同类工具。在盲测对比中，专业译员选择DeepL译文作为"最佳翻
译"的比例是其他主流翻译工具的3倍以上。对于通用文本，DeepL的**AI翻译**准确率可达90%以上；对于专业领域
文本，配合术语库功能可进一步提升准确度。当然，翻译质量也取决于语言对和文本类型，建议用户在关键场景中
结合人工审核。

DeepL可以在手机上使用吗？

可以。DeepL提供iOS和Android移动应用，支持在线翻译、拍照翻译和语音输入等功能。移动端界面简洁直观，翻
译质量与桌面版保持一致。此外，移动网页版也可以直接在手机浏览器中使用，无需下载App。对于经常需要移动
办公的用户来说，DeepL移动端是非常便捷的**智能翻译**工具。

DeepL的API接口怎么接入？

DeepL提供RESTful
API接口，支持开发者将DeepL的**AI翻译**能力集成到自己的应用、网站或工作流中。API支持所有DeepL覆盖的语
言对，响应速度快，适合批量翻译和自动化翻译场景。开发者可在DeepL官网注册账号后获取API密钥，详细接入文
档请参考官方开发者指南。API按翻译字符数计费，提供灵活的定价方案。

## The Podcast

The frontier of intelligence, explained

[
Learn more
][140]
10 years of AlphaGo: The turning point for AI

Exactly one decade later, we look back at the match that sparked the modern AI revolution.

The future of intelligence

Demis shares his vision for the path to AGI - from solving "root node" problems in fusion energy and
material science to the rise of world models and simulations.

The arrival of AGI

Shane walks host Hannah Fry through his AGI framework, breaking down the levels from minimal AGI to
full AGI, and his timelines for each.

Google DeepMind robotics lab tour

Hannah interacts with a new set of robots—those that don't just see, but think, plan, and do.

AlphaFold: Grand challenge to Nobel Prize

Five years ago, AlphaFold 2 solved the protein structure prediction problem, unlocking new avenues
of biological research and providing our first major proof point that AI can be a powerful tool to
advance science and cure disease.

## The Podcast

The frontier of intelligence, explained

[
Learn more
][140]
10 years of AlphaGo: The turning point for AI

Exactly one decade later, we look back at the match that sparked the modern AI revolution.

The future of intelligence

Demis shares his vision for the path to AGI - from solving "root node" problems in fusion energy and
material science to the rise of world models and simulations.

The arrival of AGI

Shane walks host Hannah Fry through his AGI framework, breaking down the levels from minimal AGI to
full AGI, and his timelines for each.

Google DeepMind robotics lab tour

Hannah interacts with a new set of robots—those that don't just see, but think, plan, and do.

AlphaFold: Grand challenge to Nobel Prize

Five years ago, AlphaFold 2 solved the protein structure prediction problem, unlocking new avenues
of biological research and providing our first major proof point that AI can be a powerful tool to
advance science and cure disease.

  You can subscribe to any of our Web Tracker plans by clicking the "Get Started" button on the

* Can I upgrade from the Starter plan to the Advanced plan?
  Yes, you can upgrade from the Starter plan to the Advanced plan at any time. Contact our support
  team, and they will assist you with upgrading your subscription.

  Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with the service, simply
  contact us within 7 days of your purchase to request a refund.

  We offer 24/7 support for Advanced plan users and business hours support for Starter plan users.
  Our dedicated team is available to assist with any issues related to tracking, reporting, and
  general usage of our tools.
* What are the benefits of real-time website tracking?
  Real-time tracking allows you to stay up to date with changes on your website and competitor
  websites. You'll receive alerts as soon as changes are detected, helping you make timely
  adjustments to your marketing strategy and stay ahead of the competition.
* What does Competitor Monitoring involve?
  Competitor Monitoring tracks changes to your competitors' websites, including new content, changes
  in structure, and removed pages. This feature provides valuable insights that can be used to
  adjust your strategies and stay competitive in the market.
* How do I set up custom alerts and notifications?
  You can easily set up custom alerts for specific URLs, competitors, or website sections via the
  dashboard. These alerts will notify you by email whenever significant changes are detected, such
  as new or deleted content.
* What is included in the weekly reports?
  Our weekly reports provide a summary of website activity, including new pages, deleted content,
  and overall performance insights. These reports help you stay informed about the changes happening
  on your website or your competitors' sites.
* How does Web Tracker compare to other tools like Ahrefs or SEMrush?
  Web Tracker focuses on real-time website monitoring, competitor tracking, and actionable insights.
  While Ahrefs and SEMrush provide excellent SEO analysis, our tool offers a unique combination of
  real-time tracking and deep competitor insights, making it ideal for businesses and agencies that
  need to monitor multiple websites across different industries.

  You can subscribe to any of our Web Tracker plans by clicking the "Get Started" button on the
  respective plan page. This will redirect you to the subscription form where you can choose the

* Can I upgrade from the Starter plan to the Advanced plan?
  Yes, you can upgrade from the Starter plan to the Advanced plan at any time. Contact our support
  team, and they will assist you with upgrading your subscription.
* Do you offer refunds?
  Yes, we offer a 7-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with the service, simply
  contact us within 7 days of your purchase to request a refund.
* What support do you offer for Web Tracker users?
  We offer 24/7 support for Advanced plan users and business hours support for Starter plan users.
  Our dedicated team is available to assist with any issues related to tracking, reporting, and
  general usage of our tools.
* What are the benefits of real-time website tracking?
  Real-time tracking allows you to stay up to date with changes on your website and competitor
  websites. You'll receive alerts as soon as changes are detected, helping you make timely
  adjustments to your marketing strategy and stay ahead of the competition.
* What does Competitor Monitoring involve?
  Competitor Monitoring tracks changes to your competitors' websites, including new content, changes
  in structure, and removed pages. This feature provides valuable insights that can be used to
  adjust your strategies and stay competitive in the market.
* How do I set up custom alerts and notifications?
  You can easily set up custom alerts for specific URLs, competitors, or website sections via the
  dashboard. These alerts will notify you by email whenever significant changes are detected, such
  as new or deleted content.
* What is included in the weekly reports?
  Our weekly reports provide a summary of website activity, including new pages, deleted content,
  and overall performance insights. These reports help you stay informed about the changes happening
  on your website or your competitors' sites.
* How does Web Tracker compare to other tools like Ahrefs or SEMrush?
  Web Tracker focuses on real-time website monitoring, competitor tracking, and actionable insights.
  While Ahrefs and SEMrush provide excellent SEO analysis, our tool offers a unique combination of
  real-time tracking and deep competitor insights, making it ideal for businesses and agencies that
  need to monitor multiple websites across different industries.

[Figure 2. Benchmarking and evaluation of InstaNovo-P predictions. A) Comparison of Instanovo and
InstaNovo-P peptide recall on the AC-PT (Proteome Tools I-III) and 21PTM dataset. B) Comparison of
PrimeNovo and InstaNovo-P peptide recall on the 21PTM dataset. C) Peptide recall for each test
dataset for all peptides, and peptides with different number of phosphorylated sites per peptide. D)
Peptide recall for each test dataset split by type of phosphorylated residue. E) Peptide recall in
each dataset for different FDR thresholds as calculated by database grounding. F) Peptide recall for
different FDR thresholds, split by phosphorylated residue type in the FGFR2 dataset.]

Santos* | *Konstantinos Kalogeropoulos*

[The paper introduces InstaNexus, an optimized, end-to-end workflow for direct protein sequencing.
It combines multi-protease sample preparation, AI-driven de novo peptide sequencing using InstaNovo,
and a novel assembly pipeline to reconstruct contiguous protein sequences. InstaNexus demonstrates
high accuracy and coverage across diverse proteins like nanobodies, antibodies, and de novo designed
binders, offering promising applications in therapeutic discovery and immune profiling without
relying on reference genomes.]

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is NoteGPT?

NoteGPT is designed to help learners and creators work 10× faster across summarizing, learning,
research, writing, visual expression, image creation, and audio creation.

### Can NoteGPT handle YouTube videos without subtitles or YouTube playlists?

Yes, absolutely. Just use the [YouTube Video Summarizer][82] to get started.

### Can NoteGPT turn videos or lectures into text?

Yes. It converts YouTube, lectures, meetings, and recordings into accurate text in any language.
Just use the [AI Transcriber][83] to get started.

### Does NoteGPT summarize long documents?

Yes. It provides clear, comprehensive summaries for PDFs, papers, lectures, PPTs, and videos. Just
use the [AI Summarizer][84] to get started.

### Can I create voices, podcasts, or audio lessons?

Yes. You can use our realistic voice library, clone a stable voice, or design a new one, then turn
text into natural [speech][85] for lessons or [podcasts][86].

### Can NoteGPT generate visuals or edit images from text?

Yes. You can [create infographics][87], [modify images][88] with a sentence, and design visuals for
teaching or presentations.

### Does NoteGPT help with research and writing?

Yes. It includes an [AI Detector][89], [AI Humanizer][90], [AI Essay Writer][91], and [multilingual
PDF translation][92] for academic work.

### Can I chat with different AI models inside NoteGPT?

Yes. You can chat with [ChatGPT][93], [DeepSeek][94], [Claude][95], [Gemini][96], and more to learn,
research, and create efficiently.

### Is NoteGPT free?

Yes. Some core features are free, while premium features require a paid plan. See [Pricing][97] for
details.

### How do I cancel my subscription?

Log in and go to [My Subscriptions][98] in your account to cancel. For details, see the
[Subscription Policy][99].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is NoteGPT?

NoteGPT is designed to help learners and creators work 10× faster across summarizing, learning,
research, writing, visual expression, image creation, and audio creation.

### Can NoteGPT handle YouTube videos without subtitles or YouTube playlists?

Yes, absolutely. Just use the [YouTube Video Summarizer][82] to get started.

### Can NoteGPT turn videos or lectures into text?

Yes. It converts YouTube, lectures, meetings, and recordings into accurate text in any language.
Just use the [AI Transcriber][83] to get started.

### Does NoteGPT summarize long documents?

Yes. It provides clear, comprehensive summaries for PDFs, papers, lectures, PPTs, and videos. Just
use the [AI Summarizer][84] to get started.

### Can I create voices, podcasts, or audio lessons?

Yes. You can use our realistic voice library, clone a stable voice, or design a new one, then turn
text into natural [speech][85] for lessons or [podcasts][86].

### Can NoteGPT generate visuals or edit images from text?

Yes. You can [create infographics][87], [modify images][88] with a sentence, and design visuals for
teaching or presentations.

### Does NoteGPT help with research and writing?

Yes. It includes an [AI Detector][89], [AI Humanizer][90], [AI Essay Writer][91], and [multilingual
PDF translation][92] for academic work.

### Can I chat with different AI models inside NoteGPT?

Yes. You can chat with [ChatGPT][93], [DeepSeek][94], [Claude][95], [Gemini][96], and more to learn,
research, and create efficiently.

### Is NoteGPT free?

Yes. Some core features are free, while premium features require a paid plan. See [Pricing][97] for
details.

[Фото Якова Лурье, СЕО OrbitSoft]
Iakov Lurye

As a dedicated software services company, we engage in testing ideas daily, both internally and
those proposed by clients. Through our consulting services, we've observed that only a fraction,
typically less than ten percent, of these ideas materialize into viable solutions, which is a
natural part of the process.

Generating numerous ideas is beneficial as they serve as hypotheses that require validation. Those
that prove unsuccessful are swiftly discarded, allowing us to focus on the next potential solution.
Conversely, successful ideas warrant further development into software applications.

Many businesses become entrenched in their ideas, making it challenging to let go. They may persist
in tinkering with them or prematurely launch them in hopes of eventual success. Hence, we advocate
for partnering with OrbitSoft as a service provider to assist in hypothesis testing.

By entrusting the task to an external partner, businesses can objectively and systematically assess
each idea, eliminating non-viable options one by one.

As a dedicated software services company, we engage in testing ideas daily, both internally and
those proposed by clients. Through our consulting services, we've observed that only a fraction,
typically less than ten percent, of these ideas materialize into viable solutions, which is a
natural part of the process.

Generating numerous ideas is beneficial as they serve as hypotheses that require validation. Those
that prove unsuccessful are swiftly discarded, allowing us to focus on the next potential solution.
Conversely, successful ideas warrant further development into software applications.

Many businesses become entrenched in their ideas, making it challenging to let go. They may persist
in tinkering with them or prematurely launch them in hopes of eventual success. Hence, we advocate
for partnering with OrbitSoft as a service provider to assist in hypothesis testing.

By entrusting the task to an external partner, businesses can objectively and systematically assess
each idea, eliminating non-viable options one by one.

# `NVIDIA Hopper` 架构GPU浅析

[原文地址(2022.03.22)][16]

## 0. 引言

2022年GTC大会，老黄介绍了基于`NVIDIA`最新`Hopper`架构的`NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core
GPU`。本文将带你深入`Hopper`架构并介绍Hopper架构的一些重要新特性。

## 1. `NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU`简介

`NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core
GPU`是`NVIDIA`发行的第九代数据中心GPU，该GPU被设计用来在大规模人工智能应用以及高性能计算应用中提供相
较于前代商品`NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core
GPU`数量级级别的提升。`H100`继承了`A100`上为提升人工智能及高性能计算性能的设计特点，且显著提高了架构
效率。图1展示了基于新`SXM5`板卡的`NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU`。

[Fig1]

对于如今主流的人工智能以及高性能计算任务，配备有`InfiniBand`互联技术的`H100`相比`A100`能提供最多30倍
的性能提升（译者：可能类似`AMD Infinity
Fabric`，致力于提升设备、节点间的带宽）。最新的`NVLink`互联系统主要着眼于如今最具挑战性的、需要大量G
PU计算节点提供加速进行模型并行的任务。基于`InifniBand`的加持，这些任务在`H100`上的性能又一次得到了飞
跃。图2展示了`A100`, `H100`, `H100+InfiniBand`在高性能计算、AI训练与推理任务中的性能。

[Fig2]

在本次GTC上，NVIDIA发布了新的`NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip`产品。 `NVIDIA Hopper H100 Tensor Core
GPU`将为`NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip
CPU+GPU`架构提供动力，该架构专为TB级加速计算而打造，并能在大型人工智能模型以及高性能计算任务重提供超
10倍的性能。
`NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip`利用`Arm`架构的灵活性从头开始设计用于加速计算de CPU和服务器架构。
`H100`与`NVIDIA Grace CPU`通过`NVIDIA`的芯片互联技术连接，提供`900 GB/s`的总带宽，比`PCIe
Gen5`快7倍。
与当今最快的服务器相比，这种创新设计可提供高达30倍的总带宽，并为使用巨量数据的应用提供超10倍的性能提
升。

下面是`NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU`新特性的简要总结：
* 新设计的流多处理器(SM)提供了许多性能及效率上的提升，具体如下：
  * 第四代张量核心：若将每个SM的提升、SM数量的提升以及频率的提升结合考虑，`H100`相比`A100`能提供超6
    倍的性能提升。在每个SM层面，`H100`相比`A100`在每种数据类型上能提供2倍的矩阵乘加(`MMA`)性能，在`F
    P8`数据类型上，相比于`FP16`数据类型则能提供4倍于`A100`的性能。而张量核心的稀疏特性能够利用深度学
    习中的细粒度结构化稀疏，提供2倍于稠密张量计算的性能。
  * 新的`DPX`指令：该指令能够加速动态规划算法，相比`A100`提升7倍的性能。例如基因组处理中的`Smith-Wat
    erman`算法以及为机器人队伍寻找最优路径的`Floyd-Warshall`算法。
  * 3倍性能的IEEE标准浮点处理性能：相比`A100`，SM同频浮点性能为2倍。而得益于更高的频率以及更多的SM，
    总体性能为3倍。
  * 新的抽象层`Thread block
    Cluster`：这一特性能够使程序员能够显式地以大于运行在一个SM上的一个线程块`Thread
    block`的粒度控制程序的局部性。这一特性通过增加一个抽象层扩展了`CUDA`编程模型，现在的编程模型包括
    `thread`, `thread block`, `thread block cluster`, `grid`。`Thread block
    cluster`能够使多个线程块同时运行于多个SM，并支持同步、集合通信以及数据交换。
  * 分布式共享内存：这一机制允许SM之间点对点横跨多个SM的共享内存地进行包含`load`,
    `store`以及源自操作在内的通信。
  * 新的异步执行模型：通过张量存储加速器`TMA`能够在全剧内存以及共享内存间进行更高效的大规模数据通信
    。TMA同样还支持`thread block cluster`内的`thread
    block`进行异步数据拷贝。为保证数据原子移动以及同步，TMA还加入了新的异步事物屏障(`asynchronous
    transaction barrier`)。
* 新的Transformer引擎：该引擎结合张量核心以及软件特性专门加速Transformer模型的训练与推理。该引擎能够
  智能地管理计算过程，动态地在FP8以及FP16精度之间选择，自动处理层之间不同数据精度地重用和缩放。在大
  型语言模型上相比`A100`能获得9倍训练性能和30倍推理性能地提升。
* `HBM3`显存子系统：相比前代产品这一系统能提供将近2倍地带宽。`H100 SXM5
  GPU`是世界上第一款配备了`HBM3`显存并提供领先的`3 TB/s`显存带宽地GPU。
* `50MB`的L2缓存：缓存更多的数据、模型，以减少访存`HBM3`。
* 第二代多实例GPU技术(`Multi-Instance
  GPU`)：相比`A100`，每个GPU实例能提供3倍的计算能力以及2倍的访存带宽。且本代产品开始每个GPU实例能够
  提供加密保密计算。`H100`最多能够提供7个GPU实例，每个实例都有各自的图像视频解码单元(`NVDEC`,`NVJPG`
  )。现在每个GPU实例都有独立的性能监视器。
* 新的隐私计算支持：新机制能够保证在虚拟机或GPU实例中的用户数据具有更高的安全性，防止硬件、软件的攻
  击，更好地隔离资源。`H100`实现了世界上第一个原生的GPU配合CPU的加密计算以及高可信运行环境，并且完全
  匹配PCIe标准。
* 第四代`NVLink`：相比前代产品，`H100`在All-Reduce运算中能够提供3倍的带宽，而各种应用平均能提升50%的
  带宽。`NVLink`能提供7倍于`PCIe Gen5`的带宽(`900 GB/s`)。
* 第三代`NVSwitch`：这一技术同时包含节点内部以及节点外部用于互联在服务器、集群及数据中心中多个GPU的
  网络。节点内部每个`NVSwitch`提供64个`NVLink`端口以加速多GPU互联速率。相比前代产品，整个互联网络的
  吞吐量从`7.2 Tbits/s`提升到`13.6
  Tbits/s`。新一代互联网络同时在硬件上加速了包含多播、归约等集合通信。
* 新的硬件互联系统：基于`NVLink`以及`NVSwitch`技术，新的互联系统支持32个节点或256个GPU以2:1胖树拓扑
  相连接。这一连接方式能够提供`57.6 TB/s`的互联带宽从而达到在`FP8`精度下`1 exaFLOP`的稀疏计算性能。
* `PCIe Gen5`：相比`Gen4`，能够提供双向共`128 GB/s`的带宽。`PCIe
  Gen5`使得`H100`能够以最高的性能与`x86 CPU，SmartNICs`以及`DPU`连接

除上文提到的信特性外，还有许多新细节能够提升性能、减小延迟和开销、提升编程便利性。

`NVIDIA Grace Hopper Superchip`利用`Arm`架构的灵活性从头开始设计用于加速计算de CPU和服务器架构。
`H100`与`NVIDIA Grace CPU`通过`NVIDIA`的芯片互联技术连接，提供`900 GB/s`的总带宽，比`PCIe
Gen5`快7倍。
与当今最快的服务器相比，这种创新设计可提供高达30倍的总带宽，并为使用巨量数据的应用提供超10倍的性能提
升。

下面是`NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU`新特性的简要总结：
* 新设计的流多处理器(SM)提供了许多性能及效率上的提升，具体如下：
  * 第四代张量核心：若将每个SM的提升、SM数量的提升以及频率的提升结合考虑，`H100`相比`A100`能提供超6
    倍的性能提升。在每个SM层面，`H100`相比`A100`在每种数据类型上能提供2倍的矩阵乘加(`MMA`)性能，在`F
    P8`数据类型上，相比于`FP16`数据类型则能提供4倍于`A100`的性能。而张量核心的稀疏特性能够利用深度学
    习中的细粒度结构化稀疏，提供2倍于稠密张量计算的性能。
  * 新的`DPX`指令：该指令能够加速动态规划算法，相比`A100`提升7倍的性能。例如基因组处理中的`Smith-Wat
    erman`算法以及为机器人队伍寻找最优路径的`Floyd-Warshall`算法。
  * 3倍性能的IEEE标准浮点处理性能：相比`A100`，SM同频浮点性能为2倍。而得益于更高的频率以及更多的SM，
    总体性能为3倍。
  * 新的抽象层`Thread block
    Cluster`：这一特性能够使程序员能够显式地以大于运行在一个SM上的一个线程块`Thread
    block`的粒度控制程序的局部性。这一特性通过增加一个抽象层扩展了`CUDA`编程模型，现在的编程模型包括
    `thread`, `thread block`, `thread block cluster`, `grid`。`Thread block
    cluster`能够使多个线程块同时运行于多个SM，并支持同步、集合通信以及数据交换。
  * 分布式共享内存：这一机制允许SM之间点对点横跨多个SM的共享内存地进行包含`load`,
    `store`以及源自操作在内的通信。
  * 新的异步执行模型：通过张量存储加速器`TMA`能够在全剧内存以及共享内存间进行更高效的大规模数据通信
    。TMA同样还支持`thread block cluster`内的`thread
    block`进行异步数据拷贝。为保证数据原子移动以及同步，TMA还加入了新的异步事物屏障(`asynchronous
    transaction barrier`)。
* 新的Transformer引擎：该引擎结合张量核心以及软件特性专门加速Transformer模型的训练与推理。该引擎能够
  智能地管理计算过程，动态地在FP8以及FP16精度之间选择，自动处理层之间不同数据精度地重用和缩放。在大
  型语言模型上相比`A100`能获得9倍训练性能和30倍推理性能地提升。
* `HBM3`显存子系统：相比前代产品这一系统能提供将近2倍地带宽。`H100 SXM5
  GPU`是世界上第一款配备了`HBM3`显存并提供领先的`3 TB/s`显存带宽地GPU。
* `50MB`的L2缓存：缓存更多的数据、模型，以减少访存`HBM3`。
* 第二代多实例GPU技术(`Multi-Instance
  GPU`)：相比`A100`，每个GPU实例能提供3倍的计算能力以及2倍的访存带宽。且本代产品开始每个GPU实例能够
  提供加密保密计算。`H100`最多能够提供7个GPU实例，每个实例都有各自的图像视频解码单元(`NVDEC`,`NVJPG`
  )。现在每个GPU实例都有独立的性能监视器。
* 新的隐私计算支持：新机制能够保证在虚拟机或GPU实例中的用户数据具有更高的安全性，防止硬件、软件的攻
  击，更好地隔离资源。`H100`实现了世界上第一个原生的GPU配合CPU的加密计算以及高可信运行环境，并且完全
  匹配PCIe标准。
* 第四代`NVLink`：相比前代产品，`H100`在All-Reduce运算中能够提供3倍的带宽，而各种应用平均能提升50%的
  带宽。`NVLink`能提供7倍于`PCIe Gen5`的带宽(`900 GB/s`)。
* 第三代`NVSwitch`：这一技术同时包含节点内部以及节点外部用于互联在服务器、集群及数据中心中多个GPU的
  网络。节点内部每个`NVSwitch`提供64个`NVLink`端口以加速多GPU互联速率。相比前代产品，整个互联网络的
  吞吐量从`7.2 Tbits/s`提升到`13.6
  Tbits/s`。新一代互联网络同时在硬件上加速了包含多播、归约等集合通信。
* 新的硬件互联系统：基于`NVLink`以及`NVSwitch`技术，新的互联系统支持32个节点或256个GPU以2:1胖树拓扑
  相连接。这一连接方式能够提供`57.6 TB/s`的互联带宽从而达到在`FP8`精度下`1 exaFLOP`的稀疏计算性能。
* `PCIe Gen5`：相比`Gen4`，能够提供双向共`128 GB/s`的带宽。`PCIe
  Gen5`使得`H100`能够以最高的性能与`x86 CPU，SmartNICs`以及`DPU`连接

除上文提到的信特性外，还有许多新细节能够提升性能、减小延迟和开销、提升编程便利性。

#### 1.1 认识咆哮虫

E/A-18G咆哮虫是由麦克唐纳道格拉斯公司设计制造的舰载电子干扰飞行器（麦道现已属于波音公司的一部分）。
飞行器的大致尺寸、三视图、座舱布局分别图1.1与图1.2中以及后续内容中展示。

为E/A-18G装备空中电子对抗系统（Airborn Electronic
Attack，AEA）的目的旨在提高强电磁干扰作战环境下的生存能力以及电子攻击能力。在电子对抗系统AEA中包含起
到控制器作用的电子攻击单元（Electronic Attack
Unit，EAU）、ALQ-218(V)2接收机、ALQ-227B通讯反制套件（Communications Countermeasures
Set，CCS）、多任务先进战术终端（Multimission Advanced Tactical Terminal Block
3，MATT）以及ALQ-99电子干扰吊舱。为满足E/A-18G的作战需求，数字存储设备（Digital Memory
Device，DMD）以及干扰消除单元（Interference Cancellation Unit，INCANS）可被按需添加。

E/A-18G的作战任务是压制敌对搜索、捕获、跟踪以及制导雷达系统及一切可能对友方单位产生威胁的射频通道。
这项任务包括在友方单位进出作战区域以及友方攻击机、战斗机作战时提供保护，这项任务通过电子攻击以及武器
投放达成。这项任务的目的是在多种敌方威胁的情况下保护多种友方飞行器。该任务的电子攻击部分通过由任务计
算机管控的具备空中电子攻击功能的载具人机界面达成，这一载具人机界面不仅包含经由任务计算机基于空中电子
干扰威胁感知跟踪信息处理的威胁态势感知显示信息，还包含经由任务计算机通过显示器、驾驶舱控制按钮、以及
手不离杆系统（HOTAS）上的开关状态获取的任务与指令界面。E/A-18G采用电子战战术作为进攻措施，其中攻势干
扰是E/A-18G的主要功能。

E/A-18G由两台通用动力F414-GE-400涡轮风扇发动机提供动力。该型发动机配备有数字引擎控制（Full Authority
Digital Engine Control，FADEC）。E/A-18G具有机翼前缘延伸（leading edge
extensions，LEX，涡流发生器）以及可变中翼。E/A-18G的垂直尾翼有向外20度的角度。

在设计该型飞行器时放宽了静稳定性的限制已获得更好的操纵性以及更低的进近、着陆速度。E/A-18G通过数字电
传飞控系统以液压的方式控制舵面（副翼、机翼双舵面、前缘襟翼、后缘襟翼、前缘延伸扰流板以及差速稳定器）
。前缘襟翼包含一个能够通过增加机翼有效面积以增加进近、着陆时操控性能的机构。机翼上表面采用折叠机翼整
流罩以及翼刀以增加大攻角跨音速段的操控性。飞行器的减速主要由各舵面的偏转负责。

加压座舱由电动座舱盖密封，辅助动力装置（Auxiliary Power
Unit，APU）为引擎提供了自发启动时需要的电源。

  This work proposed an explainable performance model of GPGPUs, based on which the authors first
  predict the performance of a given kernel on giver hardware with high accuracy, then explain the
  relation between GPGPU behaviors and design parameters.
  
  # 2. Strength
* The paper is well organized and well-motivated.
* The performance model they use is highly explainable with considerable accuracy.
* Some important design insights are revealed via their model.
* The performance model can be easily generalized to other hardware and other performance metrics
  (from IPS to Power consumption).

* Some findings are misleading, which will be datailed in questions and comments.
  
  # 4. Questions and Comments to Authors
0. The problem this work target is emerging and important, and the authors explain their motivation
   well.

   design factor. While this parameter is not the most challenging factor the hardware designers
   concerned. It’s trival that with higher frequency the performance and power of a GPGPU kernel

# Introduction

It’s universally acknowledged that deep learning applications are evolving fast and are becoming
more and more complex. For example, In cloud service and auto-piloting, we need to provide service
to several deep learning models. However, currently, the computation power of hardware also
increases significantly, for example, Threadripper 3990X CPU has ~15 TFLOPS for FP32 while Radeon
Instinct MI100 has>100 TFLOPS for matrix computation. This situation resulted in a problem that the
performance of single hardware is far beyond the requirement of a single inference task of model:
the QoS requirement of ResNet-50 in MLPerf is 15ms while the whole CPU use only 6ms to finish the
job.
Under this circumstance, we need multi-tenant. In another word, we need to co-locate multiple tasks,
or queries, onto one hardware.

# Current Solutions

We can divide current solutions into hardware and software solutions. The hardware solutions mainly
bypass the complex resource management of co-locating tasks by temporal sharing or physical
isolation, like AI-MT for temporal sharing and NVIDIA MIG for resource isolation. For software
solutions, there are some task co-locating solutions for traditional workloads including Parties,
for deep learning tasks, DART proposed a cluster scale scheduling strategy. While our work mainly
focuses on CPU scale strategy.

### A straightforward solution

Of course, we have some simple, straightforward solutions. On CPUs, we can use MPI to serve multiple
tasks and use CPU affinity and tools including res control, Intel CAT to limit resource usage. On
GPUs, we have Multi-Process Service, Persistent Thread Block. These techniques support simply
dumping multiple tasks onto single hardware. But how about the performance? It’s not good. Following

#### 1.1 认识咆哮虫

E/A-18G咆哮虫是由麦克唐纳道格拉斯公司设计制造的舰载电子干扰飞行器（麦道现已属于波音公司的一部分）。
飞行器的大致尺寸、三视图、座舱布局分别图1.1与图1.2中以及后续内容中展示。

为E/A-18G装备空中电子对抗系统（Airborn Electronic
Attack，AEA）的目的旨在提高强电磁干扰作战环境下的生存能力以及电子攻击能力。在电子对抗系统AEA中包含起
到控制器作用的电子攻击单元（Electronic Attack
Unit，EAU）、ALQ-218(V)2接收机、ALQ-227B通讯反制套件（Communications Countermeasures
Set，CCS）、多任务先进战术终端（Multimission Advanced Tactical Terminal Block
3，MATT）以及ALQ-99电子干扰吊舱。为满足E/A-18G的作战需求，数字存储设备（Digital Memory
Device，DMD）以及干扰消除单元（Interference Cancellation Unit，INCANS）可被按需添加。

E/A-18G的作战任务是压制敌对搜索、捕获、跟踪以及制导雷达系统及一切可能对友方单位产生威胁的射频通道。
这项任务包括在友方单位进出作战区域以及友方攻击机、战斗机作战时提供保护，这项任务通过电子攻击以及武器
投放达成。这项任务的目的是在多种敌方威胁的情况下保护多种友方飞行器。该任务的电子攻击部分通过由任务计
算机管控的具备空中电子攻击功能的载具人机界面达成，这一载具人机界面不仅包含经由任务计算机基于空中电子
干扰威胁感知跟踪信息处理的威胁态势感知显示信息，还包含经由任务计算机通过显示器、驾驶舱控制按钮、以及
手不离杆系统（HOTAS）上的开关状态获取的任务与指令界面。E/A-18G采用电子战战术作为进攻措施，其中攻势干
扰是E/A-18G的主要功能。

E/A-18G由两台通用动力F414-GE-400涡轮风扇发动机提供动力。该型发动机配备有数字引擎控制（Full Authority
Digital Engine Control，FADEC）。E/A-18G具有机翼前缘延伸（leading edge
extensions，LEX，涡流发生器）以及可变中翼。E/A-18G的垂直尾翼有向外20度的角度。

在设计该型飞行器时放宽了静稳定性的限制已获得更好的操纵性以及更低的进近、着陆速度。E/A-18G通过数字电
传飞控系统以液压的方式控制舵面（副翼、机翼双舵面、前缘襟翼、后缘襟翼、前缘延伸扰流板以及差速稳定器）
。前缘襟翼包含一个能够通过增加机翼有效面积以增加进近、着陆时操控性能的机构。机翼上表面采用折叠机翼整
流罩以及翼刀以增加大攻角跨音速段的操控性。飞行器的减速主要由各舵面的偏转负责。

加压座舱由电动座舱盖密封，辅助动力装置（Auxiliary Power
Unit，APU）为引擎提供了自发启动时需要的电源。

## [Review Log: QIG: Quantifying the Importance and Interaction of GPGPU Architecture Parameters
## (TCAD VOL.37, NO.6, 2018)][18]

Posted on 2022-05-05

# 0. 开始之前及总体感想
* 文章标题：Review Log: QIG: Quantifying the Importance and Interaction of GPGPU Architecture
  Parameters
* 期刊/会议：TCAD VOL.37, NO.6, 2018
* 这篇文章和我下一个想做的工作有重合，所以会以较为aggressive的态度来写review log（
* 本文主要介绍了一种用于GPU设计过程中设计空间探索（Design Space
  Explore，DSE）的系统，通过将设计参数与GPU
  Kernel的运行性能数据输入给一个*可解释*的机器学习模型（有点类似随机森林的决策树算法）来衡量不同任务
  下不同设计参数的优劣。当然这篇文章最重要的贡献我认为不在于模型准确率活着加速GPU架构设计等等，而在
  于其挖掘的GPU设计参数对于计算任务的影响，以及参数之间互相影响的模式。
* 本文采用可解释的机器学习模型，在获得高预测准确率的同时能够解释数据与硬件之间的关系。然而有些解释在
  我看来并不能真实反应硬件设计参数对性能的影响，也许是将相关性解释为了因果性，详见Review Log正文。
  
  # 1. Summary
  
  This work proposed an explainable performance model of GPGPUs, based on which the authors first
  predict the performance of a given kernel on giver hardware with high accuracy, then explain the
  relation between GPGPU behaviors and design parameters.
  
  # 2. Strength
* The paper is well organized and well-motivated.
* The performance model they use is highly explainable with considerable accuracy.
* Some important design insights are revealed via their model.
* The performance model can be easily generalized to other hardware and other performance metrics
  (from IPS to Power consumption).
  
  # 3. Weakness
* Some findings are misleading, which will be datailed in questions and comments.
  
  # 4. Questions and Comments to Authors
0. The problem this work target is emerging and important, and the authors explain their motivation
   well.
1. In the analysis of importance analysis, the *core frequency* is treated as the most important
   design factor. While this parameter is not the most challenging factor the hardware designers
   concerned. It’s trival that with higher frequency the performance and power of a GPGPU kernel
   will increase. So is the *instruction replay overhead* which is a factor related to the profiler
   itself. I think it’s necessary to filter out the influence of these parameters other wise some
   misleading findings will be given. (For example, execute all the kernels at a fixed core
   frequency or fixed power budget)
2. I think the benchmark amount and the problem size are limited, and the register per thread is
   always sufficient. While for some recent applications with very heavy computation burdens, there
   may exist other patterns.
   (这点其实有点时空警察，但是2018年应该也是有那些很大的模型、很大的计算任务了)
3. GPUWattch is available for power estimated with higher explainable.
4. Overall, the findings and hardware patterns proposed in this work is reasonable and insightful.

   4

This work is accepted by ASPLOS 2022.

# Introduction

It’s universally acknowledged that deep learning applications are evolving fast and are becoming
more and more complex. For example, In cloud service and auto-piloting, we need to provide service
to several deep learning models. However, currently, the computation power of hardware also
increases significantly, for example, Threadripper 3990X CPU has ~15 TFLOPS for FP32 while Radeon
Instinct MI100 has>100 TFLOPS for matrix computation. This situation resulted in a problem that the
performance of single hardware is far beyond the requirement of a single inference task of model:
the QoS requirement of ResNet-50 in MLPerf is 15ms while the whole CPU use only 6ms to finish the
job.
Under this circumstance, we need multi-tenant. In another word, we need to co-locate multiple tasks,
or queries, onto one hardware.

# Current Solutions

We can divide current solutions into hardware and software solutions. The hardware solutions mainly
bypass the complex resource management of co-locating tasks by temporal sharing or physical
isolation, like AI-MT for temporal sharing and NVIDIA MIG for resource isolation. For software
solutions, there are some task co-locating solutions for traditional workloads including Parties,
for deep learning tasks, DART proposed a cluster scale scheduling strategy. While our work mainly
focuses on CPU scale strategy.

### A straightforward solution

Of course, we have some simple, straightforward solutions. On CPUs, we can use MPI to serve multiple
tasks and use CPU affinity and tools including res control, Intel CAT to limit resource usage. On
GPUs, we have Multi-Process Service, Persistent Thread Block. These techniques support simply
dumping multiple tasks onto single hardware. But how about the performance? It’s not good. Following

### Defect detection in solar panel manufacturing  using computer vision

Manufacturing

United States

A NY-based solar technology manufacturer faced slow, inconsistent manual inspection in high-volume
production. We automated defect detection, added real-time alerts, and enabled data-driven
improvements — helping them cut costs and increase production speed

Built a custom computer vision pipeline to detect defects without relying on large training datasets

improvements

Healthcare

United States

treatment decisions.

Built a React Native app with an accessible interface and smooth performance on both iOS and Android

Integrated securely with existing backend systems via custom APIs and data exchange protocols

Embedded multifactor authentication and data encryption to protect sensitive patient data

analytics, and reduced costs.

Refactored the live meeting module into a standalone product with Amazon Chime video, screen
sharing, and AI features like real-time transcription and summaries

Unified multiple legacy products with seamless SSO and a 9 Dots Menu navigation

Optimized large file ingestion, content rendering, and engagement tracking for sales materials

[Check out how we built it][10]

Transportation & Logistics

United States

system that cut turnaround times, reduced costs, and created a scalable model for future logistics
operations.

Developed a web-based bidding platform with real-time notifications, high-volume bid support, and
automated processing/validation to reduce errors and speed allocation

Designed a secure transaction system with encryption, audit trails, and a winning-bid algorithm
factoring in cost, routes, delivery windows, and carrier reliability

Built a scalable foundation that streamlines operations, ensures data integrity, and supports future
growth

# Takashi Matsubara

Professor at
Faculty of Information Science and Technology
Hokkaido University

[[Takashi Matsubara]][5]

My research focuses on understanding the intrinsic mathematical structure of the target systems and
building machine learning models that incorporate that structure. Drawing on analytical mechanics
and differential geometry, my research enables deep understanding and faithful alignment with the
target, while preserving model flexibility. Applications include physically faithful modeling of
dynamical systems, acceleration of computer simulations, geometric deep learning, and image
generation faithful to a user's intent. See [my research group's website][6] for more information.

**Keywords:** data geometry, geometric deep learning, AI for Science, scientific machine learning,
generative AI

We are hiring! Prospective postdoctoral researchers and PhD candidates in related disciplines,
please reach out to us.

## News

2026

*Jun. 2026*
  Mr. Shinnosuke Saito has had his paper "[Be Tangential to Manifold: Discovering Riemannian Metric
  for Diffusion Models][7]" accepted at The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV2026).
  The work designs a Riemannian metric from the score function of diffusion models to capture the
  directions of the data manifold, enabling natural image interpolation and improved diversity in
  generation.
*Jan. 2026*
  Mr. Daiki Yoshikawa has had his paper "[PHyCLIP: ℓ₁-Product of Hyperbolic Factors Unifies
  Hierarchy and Compositionality in Vision-Language Representation Learning][8]" accepted at The
  Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR2026). Our vision-language
  representation learning jointly models taxonomic hierarchies and Boolean-like compositionality by
  combining hyperbolic spaces and the ℓ₁-product metric.
*Jan. 2026*
  Dr. Haohui Jia has had his paper "ODEBrain: Continuous-Time EEG Graph for Modeling Dynamic Brain
  Networks" accepted at The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations
  (ICLR2026).
2025

*Nov. 2025*
  Mr. Yosuke Nishimoto has had his paper accepted at the Fortieth AAAI Conference on Artificial
  Intelligence (AAAI2026). His work introduces object-centric representations and causality-aware
  attention masks in Transformer-based world models.
*Sep. 2025*
  I joined [Computational Physics Machine Learning Team][9], RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence
  Project (AIP) as a Visiting Scientist.
*May 2025*
  I joined AI Lab, CyberAgent, Inc. as a Research Scientist through a cross-appointment.
*Jan. 2025*
  Mr. Razmik Arman Khosrovian has had his paper, "[Poisson-Dirac Neural Networks for Modeling
  Coupled Dynamical Systems across Domains][10]," co-authored with Prof. Yoshimura, Waseda
  University, and Prof. Yaguchi, Kobe University, accepted at The Thirteenth International
  Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR2025). PoDiNNs uncover coupling patterns and
  component-wise properties in coupled dynamical systems, offering precise forecasts and
  interpretability.
2024

*Dec. 2024*
  Our paper "[Number Theoretic Accelerated Learning of Physics-Informed Neural Networks][11],"
  co-authored with Prof. Yaguchi, Kobe University, has been accepted at The Thirty-Ninth AAAI
  Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI2025). (Update: Selected as an oral.)
*Oct. 2024*
  Mr. Razmik Arman Khosrovian and Mr. Yosuke Nishimoto have had their papers accepted for
  presentation at the NeurIPS 2024 Workshops on Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences, and
  Compositional Learning, respectively.
*Jun. 2024*
  I will give an invited talk at [CAI 2024 Workshop on Scientific Machine Learning and Its
  Industrial Applications (SMLIA2024)][12] at Singapore.
*Apr. 2024*
  I have been appointed as a Professor at the [Faculty of Information Science and Technology][13],
  [Hokkaido University][14].
*Mar. 2024*
  I will give a tutorial talk at [International Conference on Scientific Computing and Machine
  Learning (SCML2024)][15], held at Kyoto.
*Feb. 2024*
  Mr. Kota Sueyoshi has had his paper, "[Predicated Diffusion: Predicate Logic-Based Attention

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about TrueFirms platform and services

## What is a B2B Staff Augmentation Marketplace?

A B2B Staff Augmentation Marketplace is an online platform that connects businesses with skilled
professionals available for project-based work. It serves as a virtual marketplace where businesses
can find and hire on-bench staff or freelancers to augment their existing teams for specific
projects or tasks.

## How do you market staff augmentation services?

Staff augmentation services can be marketed through online and offline channels. Strategies include
creating a strong online presence, leveraging social media, participating in industry events, and
showcasing success stories and client testimonials.

## How does staff augmentation work?

Staff augmentation involves supplementing a company's internal team with external professionals to
meet specific project requirements. These professionals, often freelancers or contractors, work
under the client's direction and contribute to the project as an integrated part of the team.

## What is the difference between staff augmentation and consulting?

Staff augmentation involves adding external professionals to the existing team to fill skill gaps,
while consulting typically provides strategic advice and recommendations to improve overall business
processes.

## What is the difference between staff augmentation and outsourcing?

Staff augmentation involves adding external professionals to the client's team, while outsourcing
involves contracting an external entity to handle specific tasks or projects independently.

## What are the advantages of using a B2B Staff Augmentation Marketplace?

Benefits include access to a diverse talent pool, quick hiring processes, cost-effective staffing
solutions, and the ability to scale up or down based on project requirements.

## How will we get payment from a client?

Payments from clients can be arranged through mutual agreements based on terms and conditions. It is
recommended to establish written payment terms before initiating any work or services. In case of
payment disputes, resolution should occur directly between the involved parties, and the platform
will not be held liable for such disputes.

Staff augmentation involves supplementing a company's internal team with external professionals to

## Our Services

Our purpose is to make AI simple and easy for you. We focus on the end results and provide you with
the technology, skills and people you need to bring AI into your business.

Hire our data science services and drive your businesses to success. Webtunix is among top machine
learning companies that are ready to serve you in every possible way. We assist companies working on
artificial intelligence, AI startups as well as small and large organizations.

### Human And Computer Vision

We are the perfect choice, when selecting Data Science Consulting firm, in building a computer
vision solution. Our services cover almost every sector of concern. Our human and computer vision
platform offers solutions such as object detection, image classification, object tagging, video
object tracking, and semantic segmentation.

[Read More][53]

### Natural Language Processing(NLP)

NLP enables computer systems to analyze, understand and then act on information input through the
normal human language. With Natural Language Processing, we can improvise the conversational
interfaces of your business and handle the communications between humans and machines. NLP is
utilized in the semantic search, autocomplete, lemmatization, faceted search group and many more
services.

[Read More][54]

### Speech and Audio

Artificial Intelligence Companies offer the services of audio and video classification models that
can also be used to label the semantic segmentation. We have designed the real-time speech to text
transcription system and speech categorization platforms reinforced by the machine learning models.

[Read More][55]

### Data Reinforcement and Categorization

The data reinforcement learning is used to maximize the total cumulative reward by finding the right
action model. We offer a unique human in the loop data reinforcement platform that is customizable
to a great level. We have successfully achieved various data categorization and reinforcement jobs
such as text extraction from PDF, product categorization, content deduplication, and moderation.

[Read More][56]

### Video Object Tracking

Video Object Tracking systems examine the video frames and gives the movement of targets between the
frames as a result. Webtunix tracks people, animals or objects in a video by assigning them unique
ID’s to know their behaviour like from where they are coming and where they are heading, along with
their speeds. We track objects 100 times faster than the manual annotations.

[Read More][57]

### Image Annotation

Webtunix, being an artificial intelligence company, has the ability to handle any type of
requirements in the image annotation field. We provide text, video and image annotation solutions,
and our platform is highly customizable. The services of image annotation offered by us makes it
easier for clients to develop high-quality training data sets that can be used to train and optimize
AI technologies and machine learning algorithms. We offer a wide range of data annotation services
like business data collection, product categorization, text extraction from PDF, model verification
and many more.

[Read More][58]
